title: Coherent exact pullback coefficient family
statement:
Fix universes u and w, a prime natural number l, and an algebraic closure Ω : Type w of ℚ_[l], with its given field and algebra structures. Let X and Y be schemes in universe u, each Noetherian and of finite topological Krull dimension, with l invertible in every stalk. Write dT and iT for the respective dimension and invertibility witnesses for each scheme T. All preservation hypotheses, functors, comparisons and conclusions are quantified exactly as follows.

theorem pbcPullbackCoherentFamily (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (pres : ∀ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω)
      (K : pbcIntegralStage l Ω Y E),
      PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete X (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)
        ((pbcActualCompletedPull f (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)).obj K.obj)) :
    ∃ F : StageSystem.CoherentExactMorphism
      (pbcScalarSystem l Ω Y dY.out iY.out)
      (pbcScalarSystem l Ω X dX.out iX.out),
      (∀ E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω,
        F.base.Φ E = pbcDescentPullback l Ω f pres E) ∧
      PbcPullbackBetaSpec l Ω f pres F.base

Here the category, scalar system, operation functors, and canonical BetaSpec are those of [def-weil-pbc-finite-stage-pair-category], [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category], [prop-weil-pbc-rational-transport] and [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. The exact-family and actual rational-pullback interfaces are [def-weil-pbc-descent-interfaces]; the actual rational direct image and its beta predicate are [def-per-rational-direct-image-family].

proof.text: the actual completed operation is ordinary derived pullback followed by the completion reflector. Ordinary derived pullback is the left adjoint of the exact derived direct image. The derived-unit and derived-counit normalizations fix its shift and make that adjunction commute with shifts, so it is exact. The complete-object subcategory is triangulated: use the exact completion data and its unit-locus characterization. Its reflector is exact, with the shift compatible with its reflection unit. Uniqueness in pbcActualCompletionShift_exists identifies this shift with the recorded actual completion shift. Thus completed pullback preserves the required distinguished triangles; alternatively use completedPullback_preserves_shifts_distinguished on complete inputs, with the same unit normalization. Restrict the actual operation to the full bounded constructible complete subcategories using pres. The full inclusions reflect its exactness, with the integral shift inherited by Functor.CommShift.ofComp. Its additive linear maps extend to the raw scalar localization. For E ≤ F conjugate the localized ambient scalar-operation comparison by pbcScalarIntegralComparison at its two endpoints; for pullback take the inverse comparison. Equivalently lift the integral comparisons uniquely through the fully faithful whiskering functor for rational localization. The unique finite-quotient characterization identifies the small-field coefficient map with the canonical completed map. Invert the component equation pbcScalarCompletedPull_coefficients, using functoriality of mapIso and the iso cancellation laws, to obtain the tower equation in the beta orientation. That ambient equation then gives the stage-system associator equation after restriction and localization, including repeated fields. The unit equation follows by cancellation from this equation at repeated stages. The integral comparison commutes with shifts by pbcScalarOperations_shift; localization preserves that identity on pure tensors, hence on all rational morphisms. The raw and canonical ambient tensor shifts agree by uniqueness of the left-adjoint shift compatible with scalar restriction. Full faithfulness of the integral inclusion reflects the comparison's shift equation. The normalized integral localization squares uniquely fix the rational stage shifts, and the scalar/integral comparisons commute with shifts. Whiskering with localization therefore reflects the beta shift equation on all rational objects, since every one is an integral representative. Give each functor this uniquely normalized localized shift structure. Integral exactness and the characterization of rational distinguished triangles as integral image triangles prove stage exactness. Finally the two conjugating comparisons cancel to give precisely the BetaSpec formula.
